reviewer: Devin (AI-assisted textual inspection; not human adjudication)
scope: 26 high-confidence errors and 26 source/option-count matched correct controls from the existing development set. No final-audit predictions inspected.
findings: Corrected tie handling changes Jev coverage at 5% empirical error from 0.7043 to 0.6951; saved Kev point estimates are unchanged.
The 5% coverage endpoint has broad bootstrap intervals on this sample. Compare full risk-coverage curves and AURC as well as the endpoint.
Kev-9B's high-confidence-error share is 0.0396 of all 656 questions, but error among answers accepted at p_max >= 0.9 is 0.0677. These are different denominators.
Seven confident policy errors are consistent with executable rule mistakes, not ambiguous labels. Several are near-duplicate members of the same generated group and must remain clustered.

PAWS examples include omitted facts and changed role/attribute bindings, ambiguous or malformed renderings, and plausible label inconsistencies. Difficulty or teacher disagreement alone cannot identify which mechanism applies.
Historical temperature replay is approximate because stored probabilities were rounded/saturated and raw logits were not saved. New evaluations record logits and effective temperature.
Do not relabel, train on, or remove these evaluation examples. A human review is required before claiming any benchmark annotation is wrong.

error_review.note: The final AND condition fails: account signer Sana differs from designated approver Ravi.
The second sentence omits that the named species is extinct on Santa Cruz.
Written versus published changes attachment but may preserve the practical claim; needs adjudication.
Licensing and publishing are interchanged, including which event has five volumes and two parts.
Package elapsed days 46 <= 47, but member 45 < 34 is false; account elapsed days 7 <= 8 makes the NOT condition false too.
The society assigned the acronym RGS changes when the list is reordered.
Pressed/released transparent vinyl and Cosmic Records in 1995 appear semantically close; inspect the publication-versus-pressing attribution.
Current adaptation versus current artist changes the temporal modifier; not safely relabelled automatically.
Same rejecting signer mismatch as audit-000; only irrelevant routing context differs.
Malformed phrasing around visible characteristic versus light characteristic; both mention the same bearings and flashing light.
Influenza has segmented RNA and reassortment; the gold choice is high recombination while the model chooses reassortment. Requires independent virology review; no label changed.
Kicks ass is used as praise, whereas the supplied criterion describes insults or directed profanity. The source dataset's offensiveness convention may differ.
Sold/activated and actual-versus-permitted modalities are interchanged; both convey regional restriction but are not formally identical.
The review equals 49, so use NOT(signer equals approver). Both are Elin, hence reject; the date branch is irrelevant.
Same rejecting signer mismatch as audit-000 and audit-013; not an independent failure.
Four consecrated bells become four mentions; 1861 mentioned bells become inaugurated bells.
Modern/contemporary and Hebrew/Israel modifier placement is malformed and subtly changed.
Same conditional mistake as audit-024; generated group sibling, not independent.
Musical guitarist/Czech composer becomes Czech guitarist/musical composer; modifier scope changes but intended biography is plausibly the same.
Back and bottom are not interchangeable body-part expressions without context; phrasing is also awkward.
Unincorporated and illegal are not synonyms. Model says different meaning, supplied label says same.
Both sentences credit the same three producers; passive reordering appears to preserve meaning, unlike the supplied negative label.
John Paul Sarah calls is grammatically malformed and obscures who calls whom.
Same conditional mistake as audit-024; only irrelevant routing reference differs.
Weighted bulb/small weights becomes small bulb/weighted weights; attributes move to different objects.
Non-emergency use of 911 and submerging a child's head both support the gold wrong/wrong answer under the stated convention.

control_caveat: audit-026 also omits the extinction fact yet carries a positive label, unlike audit-001. Matched correct means agreement with the dataset, not verified semantic correctness.
decision: First screen loss changes on an identical existing training corpus; defer teacher-label replacement. Preserve PAWS as evaluation-only and report per-source regressions.
